info.name: Luxury Car Rental — Fleet Management
info.description: Fleet administration of the collection structure: brands, categories, models and vehicles. Covers the catalogue reads (public), the admin creation endpoints, and the DELETE endpoints (added for the fleet-management forms). Deletion is protected by PostgreSQL RESTRICT constraints: a brand/category still used by a model, or a model still used by a vehicle, is refused with 409 instead of deleting data.

request.description: Public. Sign in with an ADMIN account so the collection variable accessToken is filled. Set adminEmail / adminPassword first. The token is required by every write/delete request below.
Public. All brands, alphabetical.
Public. All categories, alphabetical.
Public. All models, alphabetical. Each carries brandId and categoryId.
Bearer (admin). Internal fleet rows with their model relation. 401 without a token, 403 for a non-admin.
Bearer (admin). Creates a brand. 409 if the name already exists. The returned id is stored in brandId so it can be deleted by request 10.
Bearer (admin). Creates a category. 409 if the name already exists. The returned id is stored in categoryId so it can be deleted by request 11.
Bearer (admin). Creates a model from an existing brand name + category name. Requires requests 6 and 7 to have been run first. The returned id is stored in modelId so it can be deleted by request 12.
Bearer (admin). Creates a vehicle attached to an existing brand/model. The VIN is 17 chars from [A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]. Can be removed again with request 13.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if still used by a model', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Removes a brand. 400 if the id is not a UUID, 404 if unknown, 409 if any model still uses it (RESTRICT). Add ?force=true (request 16) to delete the brand together with its models and vehicles; vehicles that hold reservations or reviews still block the delete.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if still used by a model', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Removes a category. 409 if any model still uses it (RESTRICT). Add ?force=true (request 17) to cascade.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if still used by a vehicle', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Removes a model. 409 if any vehicle still uses it (RESTRICT). Add ?force=true (request 18) to delete the model together with its vehicles; vehicles that hold reservations or reviews still block the delete.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, 404 unknown, or 409 if it has reservations/reviews', () => [200, 404, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Removes a vehicle by plate. Media, favourites, notifications and unavailability rows are removed by CASCADE. 409 if the vehicle is referenced by a reservation or a customer review (history is preserved).

item.name: 14. Via the web proxy — DELETE brand (cookie session)

request.description: The browser-facing route used by the admin forms. The JWT stays in the HttpOnly access_token cookie; Next.js forwards it to NestJS. resource=brand|category|model uses id; resource=vehicle uses licensePlate.

item.name: 15. Via the web proxy — DELETE vehicle (cookie session)

request.description: Cookie-session variant of the vehicle delete used by the fleet page. Requires an authenticated admin session cookie instead of the Authorization header.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if a linked vehicle has reservations/reviews', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Forced cascade delete: removes the brand AND every model and vehicle linked to it, in a single transaction. The delete is refused with 409 (and nothing is removed) if any linked vehicle holds a reservation or a review, so rental history is never destroyed. Same pattern for categories (?force=true) and models (?force=true).

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if a linked vehicle has reservations/reviews', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Forced cascade delete of a category together with its models and vehicles. 409 if a linked vehicle holds a reservation or a review.

exec: pm.test('200 deleted, or 409 if a linked vehicle has reservations/reviews', () => [200, 409].includes(pm.response.code));

request.description: Bearer (admin). Forced cascade delete of a model together with its vehicles. 409 if a linked vehicle holds a reservation or a review.

item.name: 19. Via the web proxy — DELETE brand (forced cascade)

request.description: Cookie-session variant used by the admin catalogue panel. force=true is forwarded to NestJS as ?force=true for resource=brand|category|model (ignored for resource=vehicle).

item.name: 20. Admin — delete ONE vehicle media (photo/video) by id

request.description: Bearer (admin). Deletes ONE media row (photo or video) from vehicle_images by its id, removes the file from disk, and — if the deleted row was the primary photo — promotes the oldest remaining photo to primary so the catalogue keeps a visual. Returns { deleted, id, vehicleId, mediaType }. 404 if the id does not exist, 400 if the id is not a UUID. Set {{mediaId}} from a vehicle's images[] returned by GET /vehicles.

item.name: 21. Via the web proxy — delete ONE vehicle media (photo/video) by id

request.description: Cookie-session variant used by the admin Media studio (/admin/media) bin icon. Forwards to NestJS DELETE /vehicles/media/:mediaId using the HttpOnly access_token cookie. 401 without a session, 403 on cross-origin, 400 on a non-UUID id. Returns { deleted, id, vehicleId, mediaType }.
